title: A successful download shows the format-specific success notification, verbatim
permissions_required: A role with the existing inventory-reports permission (Story 1 prerequisite).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Inventory Value report is open with rows loaded (under the export cap).
steps: 1. Download the PDF and read the notification.
2. Download the CSV and read the notification.
expected: 1. The PDF download shows a success notification: "Inventory Value report exported (PDF)".
2. The CSV download shows a success notification: "Inventory Value report exported (CSV)".
design_ref: none — design not yet available (spec-only authoring)
